result_text:
The `all_files.zip` export now looks up and names its five entries from the configured aspect names. With the renamed aspect, it should write `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in fourth place. I only compiled the `reports` module (it builds cleanly). I didn't run any tests or a real export, and I added no test for the renamed case.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the block that writes the zips. It builds the file names with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. The order is still main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. With the default configuration the names and order are unchanged.

`git-history.zip` is written right after `all_files.zip`, so it is written again whenever a `git-history.txt` exists.
